 Live Score Al Nassr vs Al Kholood Early Morning Today, October 30, 2026: Cristiano Ronaldo in Action? Monitor Scores and Final Results
 Follow the live score of Al Nassr vs Al Kholood in the 2026/2027 Saudi Pro League. Watch for Cristiano Ronaldo's performance and the final match result.
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 |

 RIYADH, Aktualita.co -  The match Al Nassr vs Al Kholood is one of the games capturing the attention of football fans this Friday (10/30/2026) early morning. Cristiano Ronaldo's presence is once again in the spotlight as Al Nassr seeks to continue its winning streak in the top-tier competition of the 2026/2027 Saudi Pro League. 
 The 12th week match of the Saudi Pro League is scheduled to take place at Al-Awwal Park, Riyadh, with kick-off at 01:00 WIB or 02:00 WITA . 
 Advertisement 
 Al Nassr enters the match with a fairly convincing performance. Conversely, Al Kholood must face pressure after suffering four consecutive defeats in the league competition. 
 In addition to the match result, supporters' attention is also focused on the possibility of Ronaldo scoring again and helping Al Nassr maintain its rivalry with Al Hilal at the top of the standings. 
 Live Score Al Nassr vs Al Kholood 
 Below is the match information that can be monitored: 
 Match: Al Nassr vs Al Kholood 
 Competition: Saudi Pro League 2026/2027 
 Date: Friday, October 30, 2026 (WIB/WITA) 
 Kick-off: 01:00 WIB / 02:00 WITA 
 Stadium: Al-Awwal Park, Riyadh 
 Status: Waiting for kick-off 
 Score: Not yet available 
 Score, goal scorers , cards, substitutions, and final results will be the primary information that needs to be updated once the match begins. 
 Cristiano Ronaldo in the Spotlight in Al Nassr Duel 
 Cristiano Ronaldo is once again one of the most anticipated players in this match. 
 The Portuguese forward remains an important part of Al Nassr's attacking line. In the previous match against Al Faisaly, Ronaldo also added his name to the scoresheet as his team secured a 3-1 victory. 
 That record serves as a positive momentum heading into the match against Al Kholood. 
 However, Ronaldo's involvement from the first minute still depends on the decision of coach Ange Postecoglou. The official lineup is usually announced closer to kick-off. 
 Al Nassr also has other attacking options through Sadio Mane, Joao Felix, and Abdullah Al-Hamdan . 
 The combination of these players provides variety in building attacks, both through the flanks and direct movement toward the penalty box. 
 Al Nassr Hunts for Victory to Close in on Al Hilal 
 The top-tier competition of the Saudi Pro League is becoming increasingly interesting heading into the 12th week of matches. 
 Based on the standings before the match, Al Nassr is in second place with 25 points from 10 matches. They are only two points behind Al Hilal, who is in the top position. 
 This situation makes the match against Al Kholood significant for Al Nassr. 
 A victory could increase the pressure on the league leader while maintaining the positive momentum built over the last few weeks. 
 Al Nassr has recorded four consecutive victories in all competitions, including defeating Al Diriyah 3-0, Neftchi Fargona 3-1, NEOM 1-0, and Al Faisaly 3-1. 
 This series of results shows that Al Nassr has the ability to score goals while maintaining a lead in tight matches. 
 However, the league position and previous performance do not automatically guarantee a win. Al Kholood still has a chance to put up a fight, especially if they can capitalize on the host's defensive errors. 
 Al Kholood Arrives with a Concerning Defensive Record 
 Al Kholood faces a tough challenge when traveling to Al Nassr's home ground. 
 The team managed by Des Buckingham sits in ninth place in the standings with 12 points. 
 In the last four league matches, Al Kholood has suffered consecutive defeats and conceded a total of 13 goals. 
 The 0-3 defeat to Al Ettifaq in the previous match further highlighted the issues that need to be addressed, particularly in maintaining defensive organization. 
 Facing players like Ronaldo, Mane, and Felix, Al Kholood requires high concentration throughout the match. 
 If they lose the ball too easily in their own territory, the visitors risk facing repeated pressure from Al Nassr's attackers. 
 Conversely, successfully keeping the defense tight could be an opportunity for Al Kholood to develop counter-attacks. 
 Head-to-Head Record: Al Nassr vs Al Kholood 
 The record of the previous four meetings shows Al Nassr's dominance. 
 From those four league matches, Al Nassr recorded three wins and one draw. 
 The last meeting on January 30, 2026, ended in a 3-0 victory for Al Nassr. Previously, Al Nassr also won 2-0 in September 2025 and 3-1 in March 2025. 
 Meanwhile, the duel in October 2024 resulted in an open match that ended in a 3-3 draw. 
 This record provides an overview of the strength of both teams, but it cannot be used as a guarantee for the result of this match. 
 Predicted Lineups 
 Based on the player composition in the previous match, Al Nassr has the potential to field several key players again. 
 Al Nassr (predicted): Bento; Nawaf Boushal, Abdulelah Al-Amri, Inigo Martinez, Awad Aman; Abdullah Al-Khaibari, Samu Costa; Sadio Mane, Joao Felix, Abdullah Al-Hamdan, Cristiano Ronaldo. 
 Al Kholood (predicted): Hamed Al-Shanqiti; Sultan Al-Shehri, Shaquille Pinas, Mansour Camara, Ramzi Solan; John Buckley, Iker Kortajarena, Guga; Yaseen Al-Zubaidi, Julien Domingues, Coba da Costa. 
 This lineup is not the official list of eleven players and is still subject to change before the match. 
 Who is More Likely to Win? 
 Looking at recent performance, Al Nassr has a stronger foundation to secure a victory. 
 The home-field advantage, the positive trend in recent matches, and the quality of the attacking line are factors that could determine the course of the match. 
 However, Al Kholood has a chance to provide a surprise if they can defend with discipline and maximize counter-attacking opportunities. 
 For Cristiano Ronaldo fans, this early morning match is also an opportunity to see if the player wearing the number seven jersey can add to his goal tally. 
 The result of the Al Nassr vs Al Kholood match will be an important part of the development of the top-tier competition in the 2026/2027 Saudi Pro League.
